q: Which merchant category had the highest total spend on the latest day?
sql: SELECT category FROM daily_category_summary WHERE ds = (SELECT max(ds) FROM daily_category_summary) GROUP BY category ORDER BY sum(total_inr) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many transactions were there in total across all days?
What is the total spend in INR per channel across all days?
sql: SELECT channel, round(sum(total_inr), 2) FROM daily_category_summary GROUP BY channel

q: How many fraud alerts fired for each rule?
sql: SELECT rule, count(*) FROM fraud_alerts GROUP BY rule

q: How many distinct cards were flagged by the velocity rule?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT card_id) FROM fraud_alerts WHERE rule = 'velocity'

q: What was the fraud alert rate on the latest day, as a percentage of transactions?
sql: SELECT round(100.0 * (SELECT count(*) FROM fraud_alerts WHERE ds = (SELECT max(ds) FROM fraud_alerts)) / (SELECT sum(txn_count) FROM daily_category_summary WHERE ds = (SELECT max(ds) FROM fraud_alerts)), 2)

q: Who are the top 5 customers by total spend across all days?
sql: SELECT customer_id FROM customer_daily_spend GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY sum(spend_inr) DESC LIMIT 5

q: What is the total spend by customer segment on the latest day?
sql: SELECT segment, round(sum(spend_inr), 2) FROM customer_daily_spend WHERE ds = (SELECT max(ds) FROM customer_daily_spend) GROUP BY segment

q: How many customers are currently in each city?
sql: SELECT city, count(*) FROM dim_customer WHERE is_current GROUP BY city

q: How many customers have changed city or segment at least once?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM dim_customer GROUP BY customer_id HAVING count(*) > 1)

q: What is the average ticket size in INR across all days?
Which high risk tier customers spent the most on the latest day?
sql: SELECT customer_id FROM customer_daily_spend WHERE risk_tier = 'high' AND ds = (SELECT max(ds) FROM customer_daily_spend) ORDER BY spend_inr DESC LIMIT 5
